title: Chemka Hot Springs: A Swim Between Kilimanjaro and Safari
excerpt: Clear turquoise water in the middle of dry bush: Chemka hot springs are a relaxing stop between Moshi and Arusha.
body:
Chemka hot springs, also known as Kikuletwa, are a natural pool of clear, warm water surrounded by fig trees. It feels like an oasis in the dry plains between Moshi and Arusha.

## What to expect

The water is pleasantly warm rather than hot, and very clear. Small fish nibble at your feet. Locals and travellers come here to swim, swing from ropes and relax in the shade.

## Getting there

From Moshi the drive takes about one hour, part of it on a dirt road. From Arusha a little longer. Usually visited as a half-day or full-day trip.

## Best time

Weekdays are quieter. Mornings are calmer than afternoons.

## Practical

- Bring swimwear, a towel and water shoes.
- There are simple facilities and small food stalls.
- Do not leave valuables unattended.
- Take your rubbish with you.

## Combine with

A visit to a [coffee farm at Materuni](/blog/materuni-waterfall-coffee-tour/) or a relaxed day after your [Kilimanjaro climb](/climbing-kilimanjaro/).
